results.title: TensorDock free credits: None | buildaicurrent
highlights:
TensorDock gives you no free credit. The “Start with just $5” line on the official site is a deposit, your own money loaded into the account, not a promotional grant. There is no free amount and therefore no expiry, and the official page checked does not state card requirements in a way I can quote. Checked on 2026-08-21.

## The correction: deposits are not gifts

Roundup posts circulate several TensorDock offers: a $1 credit via a LINKEDIN_1 code, $5 in testing credit, and $15 credit bundles. As of 2026-08-21 none of those appear on TensorDock’s official pages. What the official site says is that you can start with just $5, which is the minimum you pay in. This is the same deposit-mistaken-for-gift pattern as Vast.ai, where the circulated “$5 free” is also a minimum deposit.

## What your deposit buys

Official rates as of the check date: H100 SXM from $2.25 per hour, A100 SXM4 from $1.80 per hour, and consumer GPUs from $0.12 per hour. At the consumer floor, a $5 deposit stretches to roughly 40 hours of the cheapest listed hardware, but that is your $5 at work, not TensorDock’s.

...

Added TensorDock: None.

Plus 1 recheck that found nothing changed. Every row links to the full record on the changelog, with the official page it was checked against.

GPU rental prices are what cloud providers charge to rent NVIDIA H100, B200, H200, A100, AMD MI300X, and other AI accelerators on an hourly basis. Prices vary by provider type, GPU model, region, and commitment structure. There is no central exchange. Each provider sets its own rates.

### How much does it cost to rent an H100 GPU?

On-demand H100 SXM GPU rental costs range from approximately $2.00 to $3.50 per GPU per hour in 2026. Neoclouds like CoreWeave and Lambda price toward the lower end; hyperscalers like AWS and Azure price toward the upper end. Committed capacity is typically 20 to 40 percent lower.

### How much does it cost to rent a B200 GPU?

B200 Blackwell GPU rental prices range from approximately $4.00 to $6.50 per GPU per hour on-demand. Supply is still ramping and prices are expected to decline as Blackwell capacity expands through 2026 and 2027.

### Which GPU cloud provider is cheapest?

Marketplace providers including RunPod, Vast.ai, and TensorDock typically offer the lowest on-demand prices. CoreWeave and Lambda offer competitive rates with stronger reliability and enterprise contracts. Hyperscalers charge a premium for integrated services.

A GPU rental marketplace does not own the hardware. It runs the matching layer (a catalogue, a billing relationship, a provisioning API) over supply belonging to somebody else. Spheron draws the same line: "Spheron is not a single cloud provider. It is a marketplace that aggregates GPU supply from multiple enterprise-grade data center partners." Shadeform sells the aggregator version of it, "Deploy high quality GPUs at the best prices across 30+ top clouds worldwide."

results.title: NVIDIA GPU Rental Prices Surge Past $3 for H100, $5.80 for B200
results.author: Bartosz Mazur
highlights:
NVIDIA H100 and B200 GPU rental rates climb to nearly $3 and $5.80 per hour, refuting AI overbuild claims as Microsoft extends data center depreciation.

 By Bartosz Mazur 

 Published Aug 4, 2026 2:14 AM 

GPU rental rates for NVIDIA A100, H100, H200, and B200 chips are climbing steadily, contradicting the idea that AI infrastructure is already overbuilt. Buyers and operators should note that compute costs are rising rather than falling as new capacity comes online. The upward movement in rental rates indicates that demand for high-end AI accelerators continues to exceed available supply.

...

Data center operators are facing higher hourly costs for these specific GPU generations, which impacts their overall cloud pricing strategies. The H100, a workhorse for large language model training, has seen its rental price jump from just under $2 per hour in January 2026 to nearly $3 per hour. The newer B200, designed for even heavier workloads, has moved from below $5 per hour to a range of $5.50 to $5.80 per hour.

...

The confirmed facts show a clear upward trajectory in GPU rental costs for NVIDIA's major AI accelerators. H100 rates approach $3 per hour while B200 rates hover near $5.80 per hour. These figures, combined with Microsoft's extended depreciation timeline, define the current economic landscape for AI hardware operators.

highlights:
On each provider's own pricing page on Nov 3, 2026, Crusoe had the cheapest on-demand H100 ($3.90 a GPU-hour, rising to $4.50 on Dec 1) and Lambda the cheapest B200 ($6.69). CoreWeave was the most expensive on demand, but its fixed spot prices undercut everyone's on-demand rate. The full table, the catches, and where the marketplace tier sits.

...

Which big GPU cloud is cheapest for H100 and B200? On each provider's own pricing page on November 3, 2026: for the H100, Crusoe at $3.90 per GPU-hour on demand, with Lambda a cent behind at $3.99 on an 8-GPU instance. For the B200, Lambda at $6.69 per GPU-hour (8x), well under Nebius ($8.50) and CoreWeave ($8.60). CoreWeave is the most expensive on demand, but if your job can be interrupted its published spot prices ($2.46 an H100, $4.26 a B200, per GPU) undercut everyone's on-demand rate. Two dates to know: Crusoe's own page says its H100 goes to $4.50 on December 1, 2026, which hands the cheapest on-demand H100 to Lambda.

## The short answer (read Nov 3, 2026)

Among CoreWeave, Nebius, Lambda and Crusoe, the cheapest on-demand H100 on November 3, 2026 was Crusoe at $3.90 per GPU-hour, then Lambda at $3.99 (8x instance), Nebius at $4.50 and CoreWeave at $6.16 (an 8-GPU node at $49.24 an hour). Crusoe's page says its H100 rises to $4.50 on December 1, 2026. The cheapest on-demand B200 was Lambda at $6.69 per GPU-hour (8x; $6.99 on one GPU), then Nebius at $8.50 and CoreWeave at $8.60; Crusoe's B200 is contact-sales. For interruptible work, CoreWeave's spot nodes work out to $2.46 per H100 and $4.26 per B200, and Nebius preemptible starts from $0.79 (H100) and $0.99 (B200) at a dynamic rate. Smaller clouds go lower still: Hyperstack listed a B200 at $6.00 and an H100 at $2.50.

Vast and Runpod prices come from our own price feed (snapshot 15:20 UTC, Nov 3, 2026), which also powers the compare page. A listed price doesn't guarantee capacity. We earn referral fees from Vast and Runpod, not from CoreWeave, Nebius, Lambda, Crusoe, Hyperstack or GMI Cloud, and that doesn't change any number on this page.

results.title: TensorDock: что это, почасовая и долгосрочная аренда GPU | Aiprotokol
highlights:
### Почасовая аренда

Почасовая аренда оплачивается за каждый час работы инстанса. Она идеальна для экспериментов, fine-tuning и задач с непостоянной нагрузкой.

...

### Долгосрочная аренда

Долгосрочная аренда предлагает скидки 30-50% в обмен на обязательство использования в течение недель или месяцев. Это выгодно для обучения моделей и постоянного инференса.

Совет: для задач с известным сроком выполнения (обучение, рендеринг) рассчитывайте долгосрочный тариф - он окупается при нагрузке свыше нескольких дней.

Правильный выбор модели оплаты позволяет существенно сократить бюджет на вычислительные мощности.
